author: nickyeow

english.text: My mother often said that time is money.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 waa6 si4 gaan1 zau6 hai6 gam1 cin4。
text: 我阿媽成日話時間就係金錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.

jyutping: pou4 tou4 zau2 ge3 mei6 dou6 hou2 sau6 tin1 hei3 jing2 hoeng2。
text: 葡萄酒嘅味道好受天氣影響。

author: nickyeow

english.text: A real friend is like a rare bird.

jyutping: jat1 go3 zan1 zing3 ge3 pang4 jau5 zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 zek3 hei1 jau5 ge3 zoek3 zai2 gam2。
text: 一個真正嘅朋友就好似一隻稀有嘅雀仔噉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sorry honey, I'm still stuck at the office.

jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3 lou5 po4，ngo5 zung6 hai2 gung1 si1 mei6 zau2 dak1 aa3。
text: 唔好意思呀老婆，我仲喺公司未走得呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can you handle it?

jyutping: nei5 gaau2 m4 gaau2 dak1 dim6 gaa3？
text: 你搞唔搞得掂㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He doesn't want me to go, but I mean to.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 soeng2 ngo5 heoi3，daan6 hai6 ngo5 nam2 zyu6 heoi3。
text: 佢唔想我去，但係我諗住去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "When do you get up?" "I get up at eight."

jyutping: 「nei5 gei2 dim2 zung1 hei2 san1 gaa3？」「ngo5 baat3 dim2 zung1 hei2 san1。」
text: 「你幾點鐘起身㗎？」「我八點鐘起身。」

author: fercheung

english.text: He has a good school record.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 ge3 sing4 zik1 hou2 hou2。
text: 佢喺學校嘅成績好好。

author: fercheung

english.text: He left the country after his grandfather's death.

jyutping: zi6 cung4 je4 je2 gwo3 zo2 san1 zi1 hau6，keoi5 zau6 ceot1 zo2 gwok3。
text: 自從爺爺過咗身之後，佢就出咗國。

author: kaistanb

english.text: Look!

jyutping: tai2 haa2！
text: 睇吓！

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm not really into dogs; I'm more of a cat person.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou3 zung1 ji3 gau2；ngo5 dou1 hai6 zung1 ji3 maau1 do1 di1。
text: 我唔係好鍾意狗；我都係鍾意貓多啲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I think we've bought everything we need.

jyutping: ngo5 nam2 ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 maai5 saai3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ge3 je5 laa3。
text: 我諗我哋已經買晒我哋要嘅嘢喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The next time that I see you, you will be quite different.

jyutping: ngo5 haa6 ci3 zoi3 gin3 dou2 nei5 go2 zan6，nei5 jing1 goi1 wui5 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa3 laa3。
text: 我下次再見到你嗰陣，你應該會變咗好多㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The kids are scared.

jyutping: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 geng1。
text: 啲小朋友好驚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We want to know.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 zi1。
text: 我哋想知。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tokyo Station is usually very busy.

jyutping: dung1 ging1 ce1 zaam6 tung1 soeng4 hou2 faan4 mong4。
text: 東京車站通常好繁忙。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: He will be leaving on Monday.

jyutping: keoi5 lai5 baai3 jat1 zau6 zau2。
text: 渠禮拜一就走。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: A lot of people applied for the job.

jyutping: hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 jing3 zing1。
text: 好多人去應徵。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Do you know sign language?

jyutping: sik1 m4 sik1 sau2 jyu5 aa2？
text: 識唔識手語啊？

english.text: The Global Seed Vault opened near the North Pole on 26 February, and an Internet project aimed at promoting biodiversity went on line. The so-called "doomsday" vault is in the remote Norwegian archipelago of Svalbard and is designed to protect millions of seeds from climate change and other disasters. The Encyclopedia of Life web site is just a click away and is meant as a source of information about all living things.

jyutping: cyun4 kau4 zung2 zi2 bou2 gun2 fu3 hai2 2 jyut6 26 hou6 hai2 bak1 gik6 fu6 gan6 hoi1 mok6，ji4 jat1 go3 zi2 zoi6 cuk1 zeon3 sang1 mat6 do1 joeng6 sing3 ge3 wu6 lyun4 mong5 hong6 muk6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 wan6 zok3。so2 wai6 ge3「mut6 jat6」bou2 gun2 fu3 wai6 jyu1 no4 wai1 pin1 jyun5 ge3 si1 ngaa5 ji5 baa1 dak1 kwan4 dou2，hai6 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 sou3 ji5 baak3 maan6 gai3 ge3 zung2 zi2 min5 sau6 wai1 hip3 ge3 hei3 hau6 bin3 faa3 tung4 kei4 taa1 zoi1 naan6。
text: 全球種子保管庫喺2月26號喺北極附近開幕，而一個旨在促進生物多樣性嘅互聯網項目就開始運作。所謂嘅「末日」保管庫位於挪威偏遠嘅斯瓦爾巴德群島，係為咗保護數以百萬計嘅種子免受威脅嘅氣候變化同其他災難。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: The investigation, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, found that women who received 2.4 grams of long-chain omega-3 supplements in the last three months of pregnancy reduced their child's risk of asthma by 31 percent.

jyutping: ni1 hong6 diu6 caa4 faat3 biu2 hai2《san1 jing1 gaak3 laan4 ji1 hok6 kei4 hon2》，faat3 jin6 hai2 waai4 jan6 zeoi3 hau6 saam1 go3 jyut6 fuk6 jung6 zo2 2.4 hak1 coeng4 lin2 au1 mai5 ke2 3 bou2 cung1 ban2 ge3 neoi5 sing3，ho2 ji5 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 waan6 haau1 cyun2 ge3 fung1 him2 gong3 dai1 31 % 。
text: 呢項調查發表喺《新英格蘭醫學期刊》，發現喺懷孕最後三個月服用咗2.4克長鏈歐米茄3補充品嘅女性，可以將佢哋啲小朋友患哮喘嘅風險降低31 % 。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Huge street parties are planned in the German capital this weekend to mark 25 years since the Berlin Wall's fall and the country's reunification. For older generations, memories of the wall, and its destruction, remain seared in the mind.

jyutping: dak1 gwok3 sau2 dou1 gam1 go3 zau1 mut6 gai3 waak6 geoi2 hang4 daai6 jing4 gaai1 tau4 paai3 deoi3，ji5 gei2 nim6 paak3 lam4 coeng4 dou2 taap3 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 tung2 jat1 25 nin4。deoi3 jyu1 lou5 jat1 bui3 lai4 gong2，deoi3 paak3 lam4 coeng4 tung4 keoi5 ge3 wai2 mit6 ge3 wui4 jik1 jing4 jin4 lau4 hai2 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 ge3 hak1 gwat1。
text: 德國首都今個週末計劃舉行大型街頭派對，以紀念柏林牆倒塌同國家統一25年。對於老一輩嚟講，對柏林牆同佢嘅毀滅嘅回憶仍然留喺腦海入面嘅刻骨。
